title: Botany
subtitle: How plants work
summary: What a plant is made of, how it lifts water higher than any pump, why leaves are green and how a pea gets nitrogen out of the air. Each lesson opens on an old experiment (a willow in a tub, a candle in a jar, a ring cut round a trunk) and follows the evidence to what plants are doing, with live figures you can push. Growth, hormones, wood, flowers and seeds are to come.
